section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Center Support Assembly)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Center Support Assembly)

content.description: Illustration showing placement of SST (Special Service Tool) on spring retainer to compress piston return springs in center support assembly

content.text: 5. COMPRESS PISTON RETURN SPRINGS AND REMOVE SNAP RING
Place SST on spring retainer and compress the springs with a shop press.
Using a screwdriver, remove the snap ring.
6. REMOVE SPRING RETAINER AND TWELVE SPRINGS

content.description: Illustration showing removal of No. 1 brake piston using compressed air through center support oil hole

content.text: Blow compressed air through the center support oil hole to remove the No. 1 brake piston.
If the piston does not pop out, lift it out with needle-nose pliers.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of rear snap ring (No. 2 brake) from center support assembly turned over

content.text: 9. TURN CENTER SUPPORT ASSEMBLY OVER AND REMOVE REAR SNAP RING (NO. 2 BRAKE)
10. REMOVE CLUTCH FLANGE, DISCS AND PLATES (NO. 2 BRAKE)

content.description: Illustration showing placement of SST on spring retainer to compress piston return springs for No. 2 brake

content.text: 11. COMPRESS PISTON RETURN SPRINGS AND REMOVE SNAP RING
Place SST on spring retainer and compress the springs with a shop press.
Using a screwdriver, remove the snap ring.
12. REMOVE SPRING RETAINER AND TWENTY SPRINGS

content.description: Illustration showing removal of No. 2 brake piston using compressed air through center support oil hole

content.text: Blow compressed air through the center support oil hole to remove the No. 2 brake piston.
If the piston does not pop out, lift it out with needle-nose pliers.
